description: This file defines the SettingsViewModel class, which manages user preferences for the settings screen of an Android app. It handles loading, saving, and providing observable access to preferences such as API base URL, default asset class, and currency, using Android's SharedPreferences.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing app preferences such as API URL, default asset class, and currency, with observable LiveData properties for UI binding.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Initializes LiveData properties with values retrieved from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Saves the provided API base URL to SharedPreferences and updates observable LiveData.

methods.name: saveDefaultAssetClass
methods.description: Saves the default asset class to SharedPreferences and updates observable LiveData.

methods.name: saveCurrency
methods.description: Saves the selected currency to SharedPreferences and updates observable LiveData.

methods.name: getCurrencySymbol
methods.description: Returns the currency symbol associated with the stored currency setting.
